node.statement: Let A be an arbitrary finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra and let 0 <= epsilon <= epsilon_E. Using epsilon_E = W.epsilon_MAIN from node 1.1, lem-maincb-structural-assembly supplies a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B = direct_sum_C M_{|C|} and one extended W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon-isomorphism v:B->A (indeed also satisfying its unused unit estimate). Substituting C_E = W.c0_cb*W.K_call, this is one extended C_E*epsilon-isomorphism v:B->A.
